Brace yourself, Aries—this fiery week erupts with hidden chances, reshaping destiny.

On Monday Mercury trines your natal Mars in the 1st House, sharpening communication and confidence.

Tuesday’s Venus‑Taurus square to your 7th House creates partnership tension, forcing hidden agendas.

Thursday’s Saturn returns to the 10th House, delivering a career shake‑up that demands responsibility while opening new authority doors.

Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, fueling romance and bold self‑expression.

Tuesday is your worst day as the Venus‑Taurus square to your 7th House sparks argument‑filled partnership stress.

Saturday’s Mars in Gemini squares Neptune in Pisces, sparking passionate, dreamy encounters that could bloom into something lasting, plus a sudden creative windfall.

Sunday’s Mercury stations direct in the 10th House, clearing miscommunication and letting you present ideas clearly.

Ground yourself with meditation and schedule key decisions for Monday’s Mercury trine to protect your energy.

Follow for daily updates.
